specificationName: Instance Invariant Storage for Impulses and Activities

changesApplied.changeMade: Changed storage read key from ['activity', id] to ['activity', projectId, id]
changesApplied.reason: Enables multi-tenant isolation by scoping activity reads to specific projects. Prevents cross-project data leakage and enables consistent cache lookup across instances for the same project.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: All activity reads now include project context. Affects all consumers of Activity.load() (~10+ files). Requires cache migration for existing data.

changesApplied.changeMade: Changed cache write key from ['activity', id] to ['activity', projectId, id]
changesApplied.reason: Backend-fetched activities must be cached with project_id scope for consistency with direct reads. Prevents cache misses after backend fallback.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Cache entries from backend fallback are now project-scoped, maintaining consistency with primary read path. Low risk - only affects cache population after backend fallback.
changesApplied.vesselCompliance: ✅ Proper MCP usage for backend access

changesApplied.changeMade: Changed storage write key from ['activity', activity.id] to ['activity', projectId, activity.id]
changesApplied.reason: This is the CRITICAL change for instance invariance. Activities saved by Instance A can now be retrieved by Instance B because storage key is deterministic based on project_id (git root hash) rather than instance-specific data. Combined with existing backend sync (lines 667-705), implements full write-through cache pattern.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Local cache keys are now consistent across instances for the same project. All activity saves affected. Backend sync already implemented - this change brings local cache in line with backend storage. BREAKING: Existing local storage incompatible with new key format.
changesApplied.vesselCompliance: ✅ Write-through cache pattern with MCP backend sync

changesApplied.changeMade: Changed storage write key from ['learning', 'impulse-mappings', recordId] to ['learning', projectId, 'impulse-mappings', recordId]
changesApplied.reason: Impulse learning data (mapping records) must be scoped by project to prevent cross-project contamination and enable proper learning across instances. Future backend sync will use this project_id for multi-tenant storage.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Learning data is now project-isolated. Affects impulse learning persistence only. Backend sync NOT yet implemented (remains TODO). Low risk - learning data is ancillary to core functionality.

before.write: Activity.save() → Storage.write(['activity', id]) → local filesystem → optional MCP sync (if available)
before.read: Activity.get() → Storage.read(['activity', id]) → local filesystem only (no backend fallback)

after.write: Activity.save() → Storage.write(['activity', projectId, id]) → local cache + MCP metabob_activity_save(project_id, activity_id, data) → metabob-cli → rpc-api → SurrealDB
after.read: Activity.get() → Storage.read(['activity', projectId, id]) → if cache hit: return → else: MCP metabob_activity_get(project_id, activity_id) → populate cache → return

vesselFlow.details: No direct rpc-api imports in opencode. Backend communication via MCP. Proper layering: opencode → CLI MCP → rpc-api → SurrealDB

multiTenant.details: Storage keys include project_id. project_id derived from git root hash (instance-invariant). No hostname, PID, or local paths in keys.

instanceInvariance.details: Same project_id + api_key → same storage keys across instances. Backend fallback implemented. Write-through cache pattern.

remainingWork.description: Add MCP call in persistMappingRecord() to sync learning data to backend (currently local-only)
remainingWork.impact: Learning data not shared across instances without this

remainingWork.description: Consider making backend sync mandatory for activity.save() instead of optional (currently skips if MCP unavailable)
remainingWork.impact: Optional sync creates potential data loss scenarios

remainingWork.description: Add explicit project_id parameter to CLI MCP tools (metabob_activity_save, metabob_activity_get) - currently using implicit context
remainingWork.impact: Explicit parameters improve clarity and debugging

remainingWork.description: Existing local storage needs migration from old key format ['activity', id] to new format ['activity', projectId, id]
remainingWork.impact: Old activities not accessible with new key format

remainingWork.description: Add metrics for cache hit/miss rates and backend sync success/failure
Update developer docs with storage key format and multi-tenant behavior

testCases: Instance A saves activity → Instance B retrieves same activity (same project_id)
Tenant A and Tenant B with same activity ID see only their own data (different project_ids)
Data survives cache clear and instance restart (backend persistence)
No vessel boundary violations (no direct rpc-api imports)

impactAnalysis.backwardCompatibility: BREAKING - Existing local storage incompatible with new key format
migrationStrategy: New saves use new key format
Backend sync ensures cross-instance access for new activities
Old activities remain in old key format (local-only until re-saved)
